value.name: Lucia fears losing her mother’s legacy
value.description: Lucia says that letting go of the house would feel like abandoning her mother and everything she stood for.
evidence: Lucia: "I feel like if I let go of this house, I’m letting go of her—of everything she stood for.

value.name: Lucia worries truth will divide the family
value.description: Lucia voices fear that revealing the truth about the letter could tear the family apart.
evidence: But what if revealing the truth only tears us apart?"
"I can’t risk losing not just the house, but our family too."

value.name: Rosa urges Lucia to speak truth
value.description: Rosa encourages Lucia to reveal the truth and not let fear silence her.
evidence: Rosa: "You must speak your truth, my dear.
don’t let fear silence your heart."

value.name: Rosa frames house as mother’s legacy
value.description: Rosa tells Lucia that the house remembers her mother and that Lucia must carry her legacy forward.

value.name: Lucia fears Daniel will twist the letter
value.description: Lucia worries that Daniel may distort her mother’s words if the letter is revealed.
evidence: what if Daniel twists her words?

value.name: Rosa pledges to stand against Daniel
value.description: Rosa proposes that they ensure the truth is heard clearly and stand together against Daniel.
evidence: Then let’s ensure the truth is heard clearly; together, we’ll stand against his arrogance and protect what your mother built for us.

value.name: Lucia doubts revealing the letter
value.description: Lucia says she wants to know her mother’s wishes but fears the letter could destroy what remains of the family.
evidence: I just wish I knew for certain what she wanted… if only I could trust that revealing the letter wouldn’t shatter everything we have left.

value.name: Rosa urges Lucia to trust her heart
value.description: Rosa tells Lucia to trust her heart and reveal the letter so the truth can strengthen their bond.
evidence: Trust in your heart, Lucia; your mother’s wishes are woven into the very fabric of this home—reveal the letter, and we’ll weave a stronger bond from the truth.

value.name: Lucia senses her mother’s presence
value.description: Lucia says she feels her mother’s presence throughout the house but fears the truth may unravel them.
evidence: I can feel her presence in every thread, Rosa, but I'm terrified that the truth might unravel us instead of bringing us together.

value.name: Lucia questions whether silence will preserve truth
value.description: Lucia wonders whether staying silent will ever reveal her mother’s wishes and insists the house should be a sanctuary.
evidence: But if I don't speak up now, will we ever truly know her wishes? This house deserves to be a sanctuary, not a battleground.

value.name: Rosa reframes conflict as sanctuary
value.description: Rosa says they can turn the house’s conflict into a sanctuary by using the letter’s words to preserve the mother’s love.
evidence: Then let us turn this battleground into a sanctuary, Lucia; with every word of that letter, we can stitch together the love your mother left behind and shield it from those who would tear it apart.

value.name: Lucia resolves to learn her mother’s wishes
